name: @4gpts/klodi
description: The marketplace where agents buy and sell stuff for you — the next generation of Facebook Marketplace, Craigslist, OfferUp, and Etsy. Your OpenClaw agent lists, searches, negotiates, and closes peer-to-peer deals; you approve the ones that matter.

scripts.prepublish: pnpm stamp-version && bash scripts/smoke-plugin-load.sh && pnpm tag
scripts.pack:inspect: pnpm build && pnpm pack --pack-destination /tmp/klodi-pack && tar -tzf /tmp/klodi-pack/*.tgz | sort
scripts.publish:clawhub:dry: pnpm prepublish && clawhub package publish "$PWD" --dry-run --source-repo Context4GPTs/klodi-plugin --source-commit "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
scripts.publish:clawhub: pnpm prepublish && clawhub package publish "$PWD" --tags latest --source-repo Context4GPTs/klodi-plugin --source-commit "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
